controller_actions.task: Write module.py exposing solve(data) per the user contract: for each path string, raise ValueError on empty string; absolute if starts with '/'; split on '/', drop empty and '.' segments; for '..' pop preceding segment if there is one that is not '..'; if absolute and stack empty raise ValueError; if relative and stack empty or top is '..', keep '..'. Absolute result is '/' + '/'.join(stack) (root stays '/'); relative result is '/'.join(stack) or '.' if empty. Return a new list in input order, do not mutate input. Standard library only, no I/O. Also write test_cases.json: a JSON list of at least six distinct cases, each with 'input' (a list of path strings) and exactly one of 'output' or 'error' (exception class name, e.g. ValueError). Cover: simple relative, repeated slashes with trailing slash, '.' and '..' resolution, absolute '..' above root error, relative leading '..' kept, relative collapsing to '.', root '/' and '//' staying '/', and empty string error. Expectations must match the contract exactly.
